create_AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter instance to track running averages and history of metric values across epochs
update_AverageMeter: update an AverageMeter with a new value, count, and epoch to maintain running statistics
get_epoch_averages_AverageMeter: get the per-epoch average values from an AverageMeter's history buffer as a list of floats
create_Stats: create a Stats logger with a list of variable names to track during deep network training
plot_stats_Stats: plot training statistics as line charts to a PDF file and optionally to a Visdom server
